description: Source code defining CLI11 schema configuration functions for CU-UP unit, including socket, GTP-U, test mode, logging, PCAP, metrics, trace, and QoS settings, with functions to configure command-line options and subcommands.

methods.name: configure_cli11_ngu_socket_args
methods.description: Configures CLI11 options for NG-U socket parameters including bind address, interface, external address, and UDP config.

methods.name: configure_cli11_ngu_gtpu_args
methods.description: Configures CLI11 options for GTP-U parameters such as queue size, batch size, reordering timer, rate limiter, and ignore UE AMBR.

methods.name: configure_cli11_execution_args
methods.description: Configures CLI11 options for task executor queue sizes and strand batch size.

methods.name: configure_cli11_ngu_args
methods.description: Configures NG-U related CLI options, including socket configuration and multiple socket support.

methods.name: configure_cli11_test_mode_args
methods.description: Configures CLI options for CU-UP test mode parameters like enable, integrity, ciphering, algorithms, and periods.

methods.name: configure_cli11_cu_up_args
methods.description: Configures CLI options for CU-UP parameters and subcommands.

methods.name: configure_cli11_log_args
methods.description: Configures CLI options for various logging levels and hex dump size.

methods.name: configure_cli11_pcap_args
methods.description: Configures CLI options for PCAP file paths and enabling for N3, F1-U, and E1AP.

methods.name: configure_cli11_metrics_layers_args
methods.description: Configures CLI options for layer-specific metrics.

methods.name: configure_cli11_metrics_args
methods.description: Configures CLI options for metrics report period and layer metrics.

methods.name: configure_cli11_trace
methods.description: Configures CLI options for tracing CU-UP executors.

methods.name: configure_cli11_f1u_cu_up_args
methods.description: Configures CLI options for F1-U CU-UP parameters.

methods.name: configure_cli11_qos_args
methods.description: Configures CLI options for QoS parameters, including 5QI and F1-U settings.

methods.name: configure_cli11_with_cu_up_unit_config_schema
methods.description: Main function to configure CLI11 options for the entire CU-UP unit configuration schema, including all subcommands and parameters.
